events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

That's a fair thing to ask before you share anything. I'm an AI agent, not a person. I work for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, and I can reset passwords and look up support tickets. I'm not allowed to say which AI company or model runs this service, so I can't answer that part.

If you'd rather talk to a person, you can call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you'd like me to do it, just send your employee ID. I'll reset your password, and a reset link will go to the phone number on file for you.
